title: The Rodent That Breaks Biology
hook: Your brain would die in minutes without oxygen, but not this animal's.
script: Your brain would die in minutes without oxygen, but not this animal's. What if a brain could just switch fuels when the air ran out? The naked mole rat can survive for 18 minutes with zero oxygen. It does this by switching its metabolism to burn fructose instead of glucose. This fuel swap happens in the heart and brain, not just the gut. They are also cold-blooded, meaning they cannot regulate their own body temperature. Most shockingly, they almost never develop cancer. They live over 30 years, which is ten times longer than a mouse their size. This is a creature that simply refuses to die, like a naked mole rat.
